name: zapier-troubleshooting
description: Troubleshoot Zapier setup, authentication, mappings, filters and paths, rate limits, and failed or held runs. Review supplied run history and audit-log evidence to identify the smallest fix, verify its outcome, and assess replay eligibility, duplicate risk, workflow changes, and task cost. Produce diagnosis tables and recovery checklists.
